lines.text: Adoni-zedek of Jerusalem fears Gibeon's peace with Israel, so four kings join him and camp before Gibeon.
The men of Gibeon send word to Joshua at Gilgal, and he comes with his whole army.
The LORD tells Joshua not to be afraid, and Israel defeats the Amorites at Gibeon after marching all night from Shiloh.
As the armies flee down from Beth-horon, the LORD throws down hailstones, and swords kill more of them than the hailstones do.

wrong_details.wrong: swords kill more of them than the hailstones do
wrong_details.true: more of them were killed by the hailstones than by the swords of the Israelites

lines.text: Joshua calls for the sun to stand still over Gibeon, and then he returns with all Israel to Gilgal.
